{{Quote|Squad leaders, we've picked up a new group of signals. Enemy fighters coming your way.|Del Goren|audio=DelGoren-Fighters-ANH.flac|<ref name="Episode 4" />}}
'''Del Goren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a technician.

==Biography==
[[File:Delgoren.png|thumb|left|Del Goren contacts the squad leaders.]]

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]]<ref name="CCG" /> and [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Episode 4" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="FC" /> Del Goren first served aboard<ref name="CCG" /> the Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]<ref name="Spiral">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=''Spiral''}}</ref> ''[[Spiral]]'' before taking a post in the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="CCG" />

He was known as a communications and sensors expert, and later served as the communications officer at [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He kept the leaders of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadrons]] updated on the course of the battle, and issued them a warning as [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron's]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] launched from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. The Battle of Yavin proved to be a major victory for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] successfully destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].

==Personality and traits==
The Rebel Alliance member had light skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Episode 4" />

==Skills and abilities==
Goren was a typical expert in the fields of communication and spanner jamming.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Rebel Tech}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Del Goren was played by actor [[Burnell Tucker]]<ref name="Tucker">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodmemorabilia.com/en/star-wars/burnell-tucker-star-wars-autographed-1996-star-wars-ccg-number-100-bas-authenticated-card-with-best-wishes-inscription/t-24061638+p-342245908180674+z-9-2953284177|text=Burnell Tucker Star Wars Autographed 1996 Star Wars CCG #100 BAS Authenticated Card with "Best Wishes" Inscription|work=[https://www.hollywoodmemorabilia.com/en/ Hollywood Memorabilia]|archivedate=20230617112514}}</ref> in the [[1977]] original trilogy film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Episode 4" /> Tucker's scenes in the film were shot at Shepperton Studios from [[May 13]] to [[May 18]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> On [[November 12]], 1976,<ref name="StarWars.com">{{SW|url=news/check-out-over-40-years-of-star-wars-a-new-hope-novelization-covers|text=Check Out Over 40 Years of ''Star Wars: A New Hope'' Novelization Covers}}</ref> before Episode IV's release, Goren first appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]],<ref name="Novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="StarWars.com" /> In the script for ''A New Hope'', the character was identified as only "control officer,"<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> and the character eventually received identification on a card in the [[1996]] "[[A New Hope Limited]]" set for [[Decipher|Decipher's]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
